architectureDecisions: D1 — Export AGENT_CHILD_INHERITED_ENV = Object.freeze(['PATH','HOME','USER','LOGNAME','SHELL','TMPDIR','TEMP','TMP','LANG','LC_ALL','LC_CTYPE','TERM','TERM_PROGRAM','COLORTERM','XDG_CONFIG_HOME','XDG_CACHE_HOME','XDG_DATA_HOME','XDG_RUNTIME_DIR','XDG_STATE_HOME','USERPROFILE','HOMEDRIVE','HOMEPATH','APPDATA','LOCALAPPDATA','PATHEXT','SYSTEMROOT','COMSPEC','WINDIR']) from process-runner.js and index.js. childEnvironment copies only those names from process.env when they are own properties with a string value.

D2 — childEnvironment(env) returns { ...inheritedAllowlist, ...overlay } where overlay is env or {}. Delete NODE_TEST_CONTEXT from the result. Do not spread process.env. spawnBounded continues to call childEnvironment(env).
D3 — PATH and HOME stay on the allowlist so CLIs can resolve binaries and read homedir config. ExHarness still does not read ~/.codex or credentials.

D4 — Tests EN1–EN5 use runProcess(process.execPath, ['-e', dump]) and runAgentInvocation with defineAgentTool. Plant EXHARNESS_PLANTED_SECRET and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY on process.env. Assert absence unless passed in env overlay. Assert overlay FAKE_AGENT_SCENARIO present. Assert PATH/HOME present when parent has them. Restore planted keys in finally.
D5 — Living docs/living/system/agent-tools/state.md Trust boundary: child env is allowlisted; host secrets in process.env are not inherited; operator overlay still wins. No Blackboard ids.
D6 — Evidence: executed env-allowlist-probe-result.json (spread process.env, planted secrets inherited, PATH/HOME inherited, NODE_TEST_CONTEXT stripped, childEnvironment not exported).
D7 — observation.js mergedEnv stays a full process.env scan for redaction only; it is not spawn env. Do not edit observation.js.
D8 — auditPaths against this plan rejects packages/core-harness/** and docs/blackboard/**.
